description: This file defines the SingleNoteWidget class, an Android AppWidgetProvider implementation for a single note widget in the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It handles widget updates, deletions, and data binding with associated note data.

classes.name: SingleNoteWidget
classes.description: An AppWidgetProvider managing the lifecycle and data updates of a single note widget in the Android client.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Handles widget update requests by delegating to updateAppWidget.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Receives broadcast intents; triggers widget refresh.

methods.name: onDeleted
methods.description: Cleans up widget-specific data when widget instances are deleted.

methods.name: updateAppWidget
methods.description: Updates the widget views with note data for each widget instance.

methods.name: updateSingleNoteWidgets
methods.description: Triggers a broadcast to update all single note widgets.

methods.name: updateSingleNoteWidgets
methods.description: Static method to request all widgets to refresh their data.
